high_level_description: This image captures a waterfront scene with a backdrop of densely packed residential buildings. The buildings are multi-storied, featuring balconies and windows, suggesting a residential area. The architecture is modern, with some buildings having a more contemporary design while others appear older. In the foreground, there is a building with large glass windows and a red banner across the front. The banner reads "YASASIN CUMHURİYET!" which translates to "Long Live the Republic!" in Turkish.
